name: EPIC 248759060
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 8.8 solar radii and 0.93 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248759060 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.789783 (16th-84th percentiles 8.428378-9.190687), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 4,084 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.93 solar masses and 8.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,778 K at its surface.
